'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Matt Thornton DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Thornton]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' As Seen on Tom Hollingworth's Blog TM
* '''Username:''' Bren Derlin
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
